## Figure 1.1: External Debt Stocks of Low- and Middle-Income Countries, 2015–25

Type: line chart

- **Y-axis:** US$ (trillion), range **0 to 10**
- **X-axis:** years **2015–2025**
- **Time span:** **2015–25**
- **Series / legend:**
  - **Low- and middle-income countries**
  - **China**
  - **IDA-eligible countries**
  - **Other low- and middle-income countries**

### Approximate values by series
(Values are estimated from line positions because no printed data labels are shown.)

| Year | Low- and middle-income countries | China | IDA-eligible countries | Other low- and middle-income countries |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2015 | ≈5.9 | ≈1.35 | ≈0.65 | ≈3.9 |
| 2016 | ≈6.1 | ≈1.45 | ≈0.66 | ≈4.0 |
| 2017 | ≈6.9 | ≈1.70 | ≈0.77 | ≈4.35 |
| 2018 | ≈7.3 | ≈1.95 | ≈0.80 | ≈4.55 |
| 2019 | ≈7.6 | ≈2.10 | ≈0.88 | ≈4.70 |
| 2020 | ≈8.1 | ≈2.30 | ≈0.98 | ≈4.80 |
| 2021 | ≈8.8 | ≈2.70 | ≈1.08 | ≈4.95 |
| 2022 | ≈8.7 | ≈2.50 | ≈1.12 | ≈5.00 |
| 2023 | ≈8.9 | ≈2.40 | ≈1.16 | ≈5.20 |
| 2024 | ≈8.95 | ≈2.35 | ≈1.18 | ≈5.30 |
| 2025 | ≈9.4 | ≈2.25 | ≈1.28 | ≈5.8 |

### Visual takeaways
- **Largest series throughout:** **Low- and middle-income countries**
- **Smallest series throughout:** **IDA-eligible countries**
- **Overall LMIC debt** rises from about **US$5.9 trillion** in 2015 to about **US$9.4 trillion** in 2025, with a small dip around **2022** before rising again.
- **Other low- and middle-income countries** rises steadily across the full period and shows a stronger increase in **2025**.
- **China** increases from about **US$1.35 trillion** in 2015 to a peak around **US$2.7 trillion** in **2021**, then declines gradually through **2025**.
- **IDA-eligible countries** increases slowly but consistently from about **US$0.65 trillion** to about **US$1.3 trillion**.
- From **2021 to 2025**, the chart shows **China falling** while **total LMIC debt continues to rise**, implying faster accumulation in countries outside China.
- In **2025**, **Other low- and middle-income countries** are more than double **China**, and **total LMIC debt** is roughly four times **China**.

**Source:** World Bank Group International Debt Statistics database.  
**Note:** IDA = International Development Association.
